name: Stock-Bond Correlation Regime (heavy defensive)
description: Conditional defensive-sleeve allocation based on rolling stock-bond correlation. When correlation < 0.05 (bonds hedge), defensive sleeve = VUTY (bonds). When correlation >= 0.05, shift defensive to SGLN + COMM (50/50) to preserve diversification in inflationary regimes. Heavy 50% defensive allocation; equity sleeve adjusted accordingly. Hysteresis band ±0.05 reduces flip turnover.
